subject: Fix full sync loop after PSYNC to SYNC fallback (#5280)
reason: The fix changes behaviour only on the PSYNC-to-SYNC fallback path, which is entered solely when a primary rejects PSYNC with a generic -ERR (PSYNC_NOT_SUPPORTED).
